name: Indie PS1 / PS2 horror registers
tagline: Two distinct retro-game horror looks: crude PS1 indie-horror (Chilla's Art / Fears to Fathom) for found-footage dread, and smooth PS2 cutscene (Silent Hill 2) for sad / doomer melancholy. Each needs named game references + style refs, and they are NOT interchangeable.
description: How to prompt gpt-5.4-image-2 for the two most-confused retro-game horror registers. (1) Crude PS1 indie-horror: name the games (Chilla's Art, Fears to Fathom), pass THEIR screenshots as the dominant style ref, do NOT ref your own cinematic frame, and frame as a first-person game screenshot. (2) Smooth PS2 cutscene (sad / doomer / heavy-rain melancholy): the Silent Hill 2 look — dated-realistic smooth-shaded 3D, NOT crude blocky PS1. Picking the wrong one is the most common miss.
